objective: Exploratory experiment: every domino tiling of the 2 x 2 to 4 x 4 tori with every diagonal choice (the 96,416 periodic planes of PINWHEEL-ATLAS-20261107-001B's family F3), filtered exactly by whether its collars lie in the level-one law (collar-legal after one cut) or cut into it (after two cuts); then, for each distinct passing plane and each of the eight one-bit decorations left open, whether its k-fold cut admits a periodic labelling obeying the decoration's law, for k from the first legal cut to two more. A decoration with an admitted crystal fails.
status: Closed, supported (exploratory, ONE-BIT-20261108-001B-E001): of the 96,416 domino-torus planes, 32 are collar-legal after one cut and 176 after two (11 distinct); a mixed domino tiling of the 4 x 4 torus legal after two cuts, and a variant, admit seven of the eight open one-bit decorations with periodic labellings after two to four cuts; s = 10101 / 00110 (with its relabelling) is admitted by none, so one bit per tile as a decorated substitution fails in 1,022 of 1,024 cases and one decoration up to relabelling stays open.
title: A search for crystals that escape the sixteen
